stage: S2 method dev pilot (development data only; never confirmatory). Decides R*, the primary comparator, FIX/prompt adequacy (G2) and supplies the H6 ground truth.
panel_note: the same 12 development creatures as M1 (panel file experiments/walk_recovery/oracle/results/m1/panel.json); fresh seeds (campaign walkrec-dev-s2)

methods.what: FullSpaceDirector: one plan over all 17 control dims + 4 body params (edit-rule box), share 1.0
FullSpaceDirector: one plan over all 17 control dims
FixedDirector(probes=(opt_placement, opt_body, opt_posture)): fixed engineering rule, same probes/plans/budget as AI
NemotronDirector LIVE (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, production config, thinking off), full evidence
NemotronDirector LIVE without the baseline gait features (information ablation, H6)
H6 ground truth: every subspace probe (incl. opt_placement, opt_body) and every morphology probe on the unchanged creature, no plans; not assessed

accounting: equal TOTAL budget per method: start evaluation, every probe, every plan (incl. rejected/discarded), screening and every round are charged (walk_pipelines.Budget); final validation/confirmation (recovery.assess) is not charged and identical for every method
itt: an AI pipeline whose director returns nothing valid keeps the unchanged start candidate (counted as not recovered); no non-AI fallback

analysis.descriptive: per method x budget: FULL / PARTIAL / NOT counts over the 12 creatures; per creature table; AI valid-decision rate; AI probe choices vs census-best probes (H6) for ai and ai_nogait
analysis.R_star_rule: R* = the smallest tested budget at which the best non-AI method (cma_joint, cma_ctrl, fix) fully recovers 25-60% of the 12 dev creatures; if none qualifies, the budget closest to the range, recorded with the reason
analysis.primary_comparator_rule: whichever of cma_joint and fix has the higher dev full-recovery count at R* (ties: cma_joint, the simpler baseline)
analysis.G2: pipelines run end to end with ledger total == sum of lines and <= budget for every unit; AI valid-plan rate >= 80% of AI pipelines (after repair)
analysis.no_tests: development pilot: counts only; nothing here is confirmatory

inference: <= 8 requests per AI pipeline (global ledger caps $15 / 1,500 requests apply; authoritative ledger copied from the main VM before the run and returned after it)
